Affiliation:: School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, the University of Oklahoma Norman, OK, USA
Techniques Used: Hankel Alternative View of Koopman (HAVOK) method
Personality Trait Integration in Social Networks
Application Areas: Critical Infrastructure Resilience and Smart Grid Stability
Cyber-Physical System Security and Disinformation Defense
Key Research Thinking Patterns: Sparse Nonlinear System Identification: Utilizing data-driven sparse regression techniques to extract interpretable dynamic models from high-dimensional time-series data, specifically applying SINDy and HAVOK methods to characterize chaotic dynamics and nonlinear energy flows in inverter-based power grids.

Interdependent Layer Resilience Modeling: Integrating epidemiological (SIR) and social influence models with physical network optimization (MIP) to simulate and mitigate cascading failures where weaponized disinformation disrupts demand-response mechanisms in transportation and power systems.

Multi-Scale Harmonic and Dynamic Analysis: Employing Volterra-based indices, compressed sensing, and harmonic cancellation via phase shifting to detect, decompose, and mitigate complex nonlinear distortions and multi-scale dynamics in high-penetration renewable energy integration scenarios.

Topology-Aware Network Optimization: Leveraging admittance matrix analysis and mixed-integer programming to design robust grid topologies and supply chain configurations that self-compensate for coupled inverter interactions and external informational shocks.
Summary Description: John Jiang bridges electrical engineering and behavioral network science to enhance critical infrastructure resilience. His work leverages sparse identification (SINDy, HAVOK) and harmonic analysis to stabilize inverter-based power grids under high renewable penetration. Recently, he extends this framework to cyber-physical security, modeling how weaponized disinformation spreads via social networks to disrupt physical layers like the PATH transit system and power demand-response. By integrating epidemiological SIR models with mixed-integer programming, Jiang develops strategies to defend against cascading failures in interdependent information-physical systems, ensuring robustness in both energy and transportation sectors.
